message.subject: Begin homepage redesign in Storybook
message.body: Open the existing local Storybook and create the first editable implementation pass for the Westside Watch homepage. Start from NewWestsideEditorialHero and the first-scroll homepage structure. Use the existing Westside Watch design system and brand assets. Keep the established Cormorant Garamond and Noto Serif TC typography, dawn-gold and temple-stone visual language, editorial rather than SaaS styling, and clear main-site and Join/Gate navigation. Reuse existing components where appropriate. After implementation, validate that Storybook still builds successfully and return the changed files, validation result, and remaining design issues through the canonical outbox.

message.subject: Resume homepage redesign in Storybook with executable commands
message.body: Resume the preserved Westside Watch homepage redesign parent goal. Run the existing New Westside Storybook real-loop generator, build Storybook, verify the static output, and report changed files plus remaining design issues through the canonical outbox. The prior failure was an invalid local_exec envelope without commands; this message supplies the executable payload.
